rawFindings.title: Reconnect resubscribes to truncated pub/sub channels containing spaces
rawFindings.explanation: Subscription keys are stored as a prefix plus a space plus the channel/pattern. Splitting on every space makes `parts[1]` only the first word of a channel name, so reconnect restoration no longer preserves subscriptions whose names contain spaces.
rawFindings.suggestion: Split only at the first space, e.g. restore the previous `indexOf`/`slice` logic to keep the full channel or pattern after the prefix.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Subscribe to channel `another one`, then lose and re-establish the Redis connection. During `on_ready`, the client sends `subscribe another` instead of `subscribe another one`, so messages published to `another one` are not received after reconnect.
